turn.context: How the automation part is achieved, at the level of the answer: what the hospital provides, the one build, what comes out, the one prerequisite and the one blocker.

transcript.label: Transcript turn 19 · “How would all of these be achieved?”

text: The chain showed the order. It did not show how little of it is separate work.
bullets: Six steps, but not six projects. Almost all of it comes out of one engine reading data you already hold.
The mapping, the alerts, the freeze and the call-in times are outputs of that one engine. They are not builds of their own.
What you provide is short. Read access to systems you already run, two small changes in habit, and one report in billing.
chat.pointer: The drawing splits it into what you provide, what we build and what comes out. Pick anything you provide to see what it feeds.
chat.invite: Tell me which of these you want to go into, or pick another of the five parts.
chat.note: Six steps, one engine, one connection to your systems.
prompts: Will you be doing all of this for me?
What if we don’t have such systems?
